Failed-start cleanup must not requeue or delete an already-dispatched task. Make worktree create reuse an existing matching worktree, or add a worktree for an existing branch without -b. name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm check
      - run: pnpm lint:adherence
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm test:e2e

  package-smoke:
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm exec electron-builder --mac dir --universal --config electron-builder.dev.yml
